N0E.code:
function N0E takes nothing returns nothing
call AddSpecialEffectTargetUnitBJ("hand right",GetSummonedUnit(),"units\\creeps\\WhiteWolf\\WhiteWolf.mdl")
set LN[0]=A2V(GetOwningPlayer(GetSummoningUnit()),Condition(function NYE))
call ForGroupBJ(LN[0],function NZE)
call DestroyGroup(LN[0])
call SetUnitAnimation(GetSummonedUnit(),"birth")
call SetUnitTimeScalePercent(GetSummonedUnit(),300.)
call UnitAddAbility(GetSummonedUnit(),'A01H')
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('A01H',GetSummonedUnit(),3)
call AddSpecialEffectLocBJ(GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()),"Abilities\\Spells\\Orc\\WarStomp\\WarStompCaster.mdl")
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01U',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()),bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(1.5,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01U',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit()),bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(3.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call ShowUnitHide(GetSummoningUnit())
call SelectUnitForPlayerSingle(GetSummonedUnit(),GetOwningPlayer(GetSummoningUnit()))
loop
exitwhen(N_E())
call TriggerSleepAction(RMaxBJ(bj_WAIT_FOR_COND_MIN_INTERVAL,.5))
endloop
call SetUnitPositionLoc(GetSummoningUnit(),TB)
call ShowUnitShow(GetSummoningUnit())
call SelectUnitForPlayerSingle(GetSummoningUnit(),GetOwningPlayer(GetSummoningUnit()))
call RemoveLocation(TB)
endfunction

function XIE takes nothing returns nothing
set PE=GetSpellTargetLoc()
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h02H',GetOwningPlayer(GetSpellTargetUnit()),PE,bj_UNIT_FACING)
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(.6,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call CreateNUnitsAtLoc(1,'h01W',GetOwningPlayer(GetTriggerUnit()),PE,(GetUnitFacing(GetTriggerUnit())+180.))
if(XRE())then
call UnitAddAbility(bj_lastCreatedUnit,'Aven')
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('Aven',bj_lastCreatedUnit,1)
else
if(XOE())then
call UnitAddAbility(bj_lastCreatedUnit,'Aven')
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('Aven',bj_lastCreatedUnit,2)
else
if(XXE())then
call UnitAddAbility(bj_lastCreatedUnit,'Aven')
call SetUnitAbilityLevelSwapped('Aven',bj_lastCreatedUnit,3)
endif
endif
endif
set VB=bj_lastCreatedUnit
call SetUnitTimeScalePercent(bj_lastCreatedUnit,150.)
call IssueTargetOrderById(bj_lastCreatedUnit,$D000F,GetSpellTargetUnit())
call RemoveLocation(PE)
call TriggerSleepAction(.6)
call RemoveUnit(VB)
endfunction

function S_V takes nothing returns nothing
local unit AV
set NV=GetRandomReal(0,360)
set AV=GetSpellTargetUnit()
set XN=GetUnitLoc(GetTriggerUnit())
call CreateNUnitsAtLocFacingLocBJ(1,'h01J',Player($C),ADV(XN,350.,NV),XN)
set ON=bj_lastCreatedUnit
call UnitApplyTimedLifeBJ(2.,'BTLF',bj_lastCreatedUnit)
call PauseUnit(AV,false)
call PauseUnit(AV,true)
call ShowUnitHide(AV)
call PauseUnit(GetTriggerUnit(),true)
if(SZV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GetTriggerUnit(),AV,400.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
else
if(SYV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GetTriggerUnit(),AV,600.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
else
if(SWV())then
call UnitDamageTargetBJ(GetTriggerUnit(),AV,800.,ATTACK_TYPE_CHAOS,DAMAGE_TYPE_UNIVERSAL)
endif
endif
endif
